message.subject: Immediate Hire for Tech Architect (Microsoft Dynamics 365)
message.html:
Hello,

 

I am Tushant, a recruiter with Pyramid Consulting, Inc. a leading staffing organization. I came across your profile in one of the job boards and feel that your skills and professional experience would be a good fit for a position with one of our premier clients. Please review the job description below. If you are interested in this position, please forward your updated resume for immediate consideration and preferred time to discuss this opportunity further.

 

Title: Tech Architect (Microsoft Dynamics 365)
Contract 12+ months

Location: Remote- United States

Infosys/ Verizon

Pay Range- $65 - $70/hr on W2

 

Job description

What we are looking for -

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent with 15+yrs of relevant experience in Dynamics CRM or enterprise applications delivery, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end Dynamics system implementation programs in enterprise environments with background in solution architecture and technical delivery leadership.
  • Experience managing large, complex transformation programs across multiple geographies.
  • Consulting experience within systems integration, technology consulting, or enterprise transformation.
  • Proven ability to manage business outcomes related to risk, budget, timelines, and transformation value realization.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft ecosystem components such as Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Azure integration services.
  • Solid knowledge of enterprise architecture principles and implementation methodologies.

 

What are you expected to do -

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and related Microsoft Business Applications.
  • Define solution , architecture, and implementation roadmaps aligned to client business objectives.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable solution designs.
  • Drive solution design across modules such as Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Marketing / Customer Insights, customer onboarding workflows, and relationship manager workbench / CRM platforms.
  • Provide architecture oversight for integrations, data migration, security model design, environments, and deployment strategy.
  • Lead complex implementation programs across multi-country / multi-geo delivery environments.
  • Manage solution governance to ensure delivery within budget, timeline, scope, and quality expectations.
  • Partner with project managers, consultants, developers, and client leadership to resolve design and delivery challenges.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to financial services or enterprise clients on digital transformation.
  • Support pre-sales, workshops, solution estimation, and proposal development.
  • Mentor delivery teams and build high-performing consulting and architecture capability.
  • Ensure adoption of best practices in solution architecture and transformation execution.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and implementation issues early, and drive mitigation plans proactively
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation using the latest Microsoft technologies.

 

 

.
Tushant Bhatnagar
Executive - Resourcing
Tushant.Bhatnagar@pyramidci.com I +1 (732) 276-9934
Pyramid Talent I www.pyramidci.com
